messages:
elaine: Heads up — TechToday just asked for a quick quote about our latest inference benchmark. They want something by EOD tomorrow. Any objections to a short quote from the exec team?
max: sounds fine from my side. who from exec are we thinking?
devin: cc @sophia — PR needs to approve the wording and confirm embargo handling. don’t want a surprise.
sophia: thx. I can draft a 1-2 sentence quote. Preferably from Maya (CEO) or Kevin (Head of Research). Maya's out tmrw morning though.
adam: Maya is in meetings all day. Kevin can sign off. suggest keeping the quote tight and non-technical.
elaine: draft suggestion: 
```
"Redwood Inference is excited to see emerging benchmarks that validate real-world throughput and latency tradeoffs — our focus remains delivering predictable, production-grade inference that scales with customer needs."
```
max: that’s good. maybe swap "emerging benchmarks" -> "recent independent benchmarks" to be clearer.
sophia: ok updated draft: 
```
"Redwood Inference is pleased to see recent independent benchmarks that validate real-world throughput and latency tradeoffs. Our focus remains delivering predictable, production-grade inference that scales with customer needs."
```
elaine: quick legal check? @press-bot can run the snippet through the standard signoff checklist.
press-bot: [automated] running PR legal checklist...
press-bot: [automated] checks complete: no IP claims, no forward-looking statements detected, allowed to publish.
devin: great — Kevin can approve. @adam can you ping him for signoff?
adam: will ping.
adam: pinged Kevin — 1 min.
kevin: (in thread, but not in participants list) approving the quote. slight wording tweak: replace "scales with customer needs" -> "meets customer scale and latency needs"
sophia: updated again: 
```
"Redwood Inference is pleased to see recent independent benchmarks that validate real-world throughput and latency tradeoffs. Our focus remains delivering predictable, production-grade inference that meets customer scale and latency needs."
```
elaine: perfect. embargo? TechToday asked for "tomorrow AM" publish if possible. do we have an embargo arrangement?
sophia: no formal embargo. they asked for an early look and promised to coordinate. we should ask for a 24h heads-up before publish.
max: agree. tell them we can provide the quote now under the expectation of a 24-hour heads-up.
elaine: ok will send: "Happy to provide the quote — we ask for a 24-hour heads-up prior to publication so we can prep any accompanying comments." 
elaine: sending now (DMing reporter). :email:
devin: one more ask — can we get a byline mention of our Dedicated offering? probably not in a short quote but can we offer a background call?
sophia: yes offer a 15-min background call with product for context. include contact: press@redwood.ai
elaine: noted and added to DM.
adam: logged in press tracker (internal doc) with link: https://drive.google.com/abc123 (internal)
elaine: thanks all. closing this thread unless someone objects. :thumbsup:
max: :thumbsup:
sophia: :thumbsup:
press-bot: [automated] thread marked resolved by elaine at 1798765600
